platform: Cloud SaaS, web-based K–12 SIS with native iOS and Android parent and student apps.

distinctive_features.feature: Unified SIS, learning, family engagement, payments, food service, messaging, and workflow ecosystem.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Shared district data can reduce reliance on nightly file exchanges between separate systems.

distinctive_features.feature: Daily, localized dropout-risk predictions using attendance, behavior, academics, and stability indicators.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can identify students needing intervention using multiple signals in one platform.

distinctive_features.feature: State Edition real-time operational data store with cross-district enrollment, certification, historical records, and custom forms.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: State agencies and districts can coordinate reporting and student data through a shared operational system.

distinctive_features.feature: Vetted Extension Marketplace with integrated education technology partners.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can add partner tools while retaining a structured integration route.

distinctive_features.feature: Workflow events and actions for enrollment, special education, scheduling, grading, and other changes.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Automated follow-up can reduce manual coordination for common district processes.

distinctive_features.feature: SpotLight behavior dashboards and BTAM multidisciplinary threat-assessment workflows.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can track positive behavior and coordinate threat-assessment processes within the SIS ecosystem.

distinctive_features.feature: Data Validations, Change Tracker, and Access Tracker.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can monitor data quality, record changes, and audit access to student information.

distinctive_features.feature: Family app combines academic information with enabled food balances, fees, activities, stores, and donations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families can access several school services through a shared account and mobile experience.

distinctive_features.feature: Report Translation supports translated teacher comments and multilingual report cards.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can provide report information to families in additional languages.

weaknesses.issue: Reviewers report difficult navigation, confusing permissions, interface relearning, and cumbersome grade or report workflows.
Reviewers cite complex navigation, too many steps, time-consuming grades, and difficult reports.
Reviewers report limited customization and difficult reporting.
Google Play ratings were 3.3 for Campus Parent and 3.6 for Campus Student when reviewed.
No public price list; custom module quotes and possible implementation fees make total cost difficult to compare.
Direct API access is partnership-gated, and OneRoster implementations vary.
Transport, library, boarding, general assets, full payroll/accounting, and alumni CRM are not documented as native modules.
Public sources did not establish formal GDPR or India DPDP commitments or non-U.S. hosting.

ai_features: Predictive analytics forecasts graduation persistence and dropout risk using attendance, behavior, academics, and stability data.
No production generative-AI assistant was identified.
pricing_model_summary: No public price list; subscription pricing is typically quoted per student, with module-dependent pricing and possible implementation fees.
biggest_strategic_gap: The U.S. K–12 SIS is broad and state-reporting capable, but lacks documented native coverage for transport, library, boarding, full finance, payroll, and generative AI.
